issue: Memory leak in JWT validation caused cascading failures
root_cause: Unbounded token cache in authentication middleware without TTL eviction
resolution: Added LRU cache with 10-minute TTL and max 10K entries

issue: Public endpoint exposed after firewall rule misconfiguration
root_cause: Firewall rule allowed 0.0.0.0/0 ingress during network migration
resolution: Reverted firewall rule, added policy-as-code gate to CI pipeline

issue: Timeout on 3rd party payment gateway during peak hours
root_cause: Connection pool exhaustion due to missing timeout configuration
resolution: Configured connection pool limits and circuit breaker pattern

issue: Data exposure via overly permissive IAM binding on storage bucket
root_cause: IAM binding granted allUsers read access to transaction logs bucket
resolution: Removed public binding, rotated credentials, added IAM policy checks

issue: Slow page loads after database scaling change
root_cause: Node pool scaled down below minimum threshold during maintenance window
resolution: Set autoscaling minimum to 3 nodes, added performance monitoring alerts

issue: Agent crash loop after config update deployment
root_cause: Invalid YAML configuration pushed without validation
resolution: Added config validation step to deployment pipeline

issue: Email delivery failures due to missing encryption on SMTP relay
root_cause: TLS certificate expired on internal SMTP relay without alerting
resolution: Renewed certificate, added expiry monitoring with 30-day advance alerts
